attchmntText: Power & Instrumentation (Gujarat) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 09, 2026, titled "Press Release for the Quarter and Half year ended on 30 September 2026 ".
voiceSummary: Power and Instrumentation Gujarat Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total income for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 77.15 Cr, up 9.78% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA rose 44.76% to Rs. 9.52 Cr, with an EBITDA margin of 12.34%. Consolidated net profit increased 31.91% to Rs. 6.22 Cr. The company reported a closing order book of Rs. 320 Cr or more as of September 30, 2026. Management targets approximately 30% revenue growth in FY27. The filing was signed by Managing Director Padmaraj Padmanabhan Pillai, DIN 00647590.

attchmntText: Power & Instrumentation (Gujarat) Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Power and Instrumentation Gujarat Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper advertisement of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisement was published in the Western Times. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and taken on record by the Board of Directors on November 7, 2026. Padmaraj Padmnabhan Pillai, Managing Director with DIN 00647590, signed the filing. The document also contains unrelated tender notices from Ankleshwar Nagarpalika and Gujarat Water Supply and Sewerage Board, personal name change advertisements, and news reports on semiconductor projects and cancer drug price caps.

attchmntText: Power & Instrumentation (Gujarat) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Power and Instrumentation Gujarat Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for H1FY27 was 111.57 crore rupees, up 12.96 percent year on year. EBITDA stood at 14.53 crore rupees, a 36.58 percent increase. Profit after tax was 9.26 crore rupees, up 26.36 percent. Earnings per share were 4.17 rupees. The company reported an order book of 320 crore rupees plus as of September 30, 2026. An active bid pipeline of 500 crore rupees plus is under evaluation. The company raised its stake in subsidiary Peaton Electrical to 60 percent in March 2026. Management projects 30 percent revenue growth for FY27.

Power and Instrumentation Gujarat Limited board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 6,960.25 lakhs, with a net profit of Rs. 550.08 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 2.60. For the half year, standalone revenue was Rs. 11,027.86 lakhs, and net profit was Rs. 815.59 lakhs. Consolidated total assets as at September 30, 2026, were Rs. 28,622.80 lakhs. The company recognized Rs. 310.39 lakhs as revenue from operations for the period due to price variation claims approved by Ajmer Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited.
